description: Decide quantization-vs-bug with data. kv_dtype_all was refused in 0004 and 0005 with the identical divergence list (int8_kv: [None, 0, None, 7]; fp8_kv: [None, 12, 8, 7]) - a resume-path change in between made no difference, which is expected because the identity gate never preempts. Print the stock fp32 top-2 logit margins at exactly those positions plus the eight smallest along each continuation. A margin near one fp16 ulp (~1e-2) means a tie that scaled storage legitimately flips and the gate's 8-token rule is the wrong instrument for a lossy format; a large margin at (prompt 1, token 0) means the INT8/FP8 write or read path is wrong on this build. Output is in step-1.log; no artifacts.
